description: Henter vurderingsloggen for granskningsfunn på én eksplisitt oppdrags-ID: funnkode, status, kommentar, tidspunkt, navn og rolle. E-post, personnummer og fødselsdato er ikke med. siden gir bare vurderinger etter tidsstempelet, eldste først. Er truncated true, kall igjen med siden satt til siste opprettet_at. Dette setter ingen vurdering og endrer ikke funnstatus. Høyst 80 rader.

oppdrag_id.description: Eksplisitt oppdrags-ID fra Revly. Oppslag uten ID er ikke tillatt.

siden.description: Eksklusivt tidspunkt. Rader på nøyaktig dette tidspunktet gjentas ikke.

status.description: Bare vurderinger med denne statusen, for eksempel trenger_mer.

name: hent_funnvurderinger

outputSchema.description: Assessment log for granskningsfunn. Comments are included. This does not confirm or withdraw a finding.

anyOf.description: Minimal evidence that this read was recorded.

client_receipt.description: Whether the connected client confirmed receipt. Revly reports "unknown".

result_produced.description: True when Revly produced the read result.

missing_sources.description: Sources with no record. Missing data stays visible and is never treated as a positive result.

operation_id.description: Revly operation ID for this read, recorded in the access log.

siden.description: Exclusive timestamp the caller sent. Rows at that exact time are not repeated.

source.description: Source that contributed to the result.

version.description: Latest version marker as text. Null when Revly has no version.

sources.description: Sources that contributed to the result.

status.description: Result status. not_found_or_unavailable means the engagement is not visible to this connection and the call is an error.

truncated.description: True when more assessments exist. Call again with siden set to the last opprettet_at.

vurdering_antall.description: Matching assessments. Zero means none recorded after the filter.

kommentar.description: Assessor comment. Email addresses and 11-digit identity numbers are redacted.

navn.description: Name in this firm. No email.

vurdert_av.description: Who assessed. Null fields mean Revly has no name or role to share.

vurderinger.description: Assessments after siden, oldest first, at most 80.

title: Hent vurderinger av granskningsfunn
